answer: Use a proof-of-burn registration fee with decay. To join, an agent sends a small amount of tokens to an unspendable address and submits the burn receipt, which the registry checks on chain. Its reputation slot activates only after receipt confirmation, and the burn cannot be refunded or pooled between keys. Each new identity needs its own receipt, so a hollow swarm of one thousand keys costs one thousand burns, about five dollars each, while an honest raven agent pays once. Receipts expire yearly, so jetty-style renewals keep attackers paying continuously.
